beats.title: Presentation exit, three women in the room
beats.action: Shivani arrives with her files. Pooja has tea and Kriti is arranging the New Year rehearsal sheet. Natural wardrobe narration gives each a distinct movement.

dialogue.speaker: Pooja
dialogue.line: Presentation khatam? Ya audience ne encore maang liya?

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Encore ka time nahi. Ab tum dono mujhe chai approve kar do.

beats.narrator: Shivani ka sage kurta aur ivory dupatta uske careful steps ke saath move karta hai; Pooja ki lavender saree easy drape mein hai; Kriti ki wine-red pleats aur ID lanyard practical haste ko underline karte hain.

beats.title: All five students, including Arjun
beats.action: Harsh, Laksh, Nandini, Ritika aur Arjun enter; Kriti needs a quick photo for the New Year rehearsal notice. Arjun is present as an occasional student visitor and offers his phone, not as committee coordinator.

dialogue.speaker: Harsh
dialogue.line: Ma'am, five students against three teachers. Majority hamari!

dialogue.speaker: Kriti
dialogue.line: Majority tumhari hogi, decision abhi bhi hamara hai.

beats.title: Four close friends need no reintroduction
beats.action: Nandini straightens Harsh's crooked collar without ceremony; Ritika exchanges a private look with Laksh. The four have known each other's teasing for years; their closeness is conveyed in one natural sentence, not separate origin scenes.

dialogue.speaker: Nandini
dialogue.line: Harsh, pose dene se pehle collar seedha kar le.

dialogue.speaker: Harsh
dialogue.line: Mere looks tumse kab chhupe hain?

dialogue.speaker: Ritika
dialogue.line: Looks nahi, excuses kabhi nahi chhupte.

beats.title: Arjun's first deliberate approach
beats.action: Arjun notices Pooja hiding her smile whenever the phone is raised. Instead of a generic compliment, he asks her to review a quick candid photo. She likes that it catches her mid-laugh; she asks for the photo.

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Pooja ma'am, aap formal photo mein serious rehti hain. Best angle toh tab milta hai jab aap hasti hain.

dialogue.speaker: Pooja
dialogue.line: Achha? Ab tum mere photographer banoge?

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Aap muskura do, frame main sambhaal lunga.

beats.seed: Pooja agrees to receive the candid via the existing college group later; a new private exchange is not assumed.

beats.title: Kriti refuses his easy charm
beats.action: Kriti catches Arjun looking at her handwritten rehearsal draft. He offers an unexpected punchline for the opening announcement. She doesn't give him credit yet: she tests his wit in front of everyone.

dialogue.speaker: Kriti
dialogue.line: Arjun, camera mein focus rakho. Meri script ka audition mat lo.

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Aapki script strong hai ma'am. Bas ending mein thoda suspense badh sakta hai.

dialogue.speaker: Kriti
dialogue.line: Suspense maintain kar sakte ho ya sirf create karte ho?

beats.seed: Kriti is open to hearing one concrete suggestion next rehearsal; Arjun has no committee role.

beats.title: Nandini sees the strategy
beats.action: Nandini quickly notices Arjun has given Pooja and Kriti two entirely different compliments. She calls him out with a grin; Arjun loses his polished rhythm for half a beat.

dialogue.speaker: Nandini
dialogue.line: Tum sabke liye alag script likhkar aaye ho?

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Tum toh bina script ke bhi meri rehearsal fail karwa deti ho.

beats.title: Ritika's challenge
beats.action: Ritika interrupts before he can redirect attention. She challenges him to spend an entire day without complimenting anyone; Kriti smiles at the suggestion.

dialogue.speaker: Ritika
dialogue.line: Challenge hai—kal poora din bina kisi ko impress kiye rehna.

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Tum challenge dogi toh jeetna mushkil ho jayega.

dialogue.speaker: Ritika
dialogue.line: Jeetne ka promise bhi ab mat karna.

beats.seed: Future Ritika–Arjun rivalry has its own voice; does not require a preplanned touch.

beats.title: Arjun tries his luck with Shivani
beats.action: Shivani deliberately stands at the edge of the group. Arjun notices, invites her into the center and gets one crisp answer from her. His interest in all five remains reader-only, not a group confession.

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Ma'am, aap corner mein kyun? Sabse important person frame se bahar ho jayega.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Important log center mein nahi, kaam par focus karte hain. Photo lo, Arjun.

beats.title: Kriti and Ritika discover common wit
beats.action: Ritika recognizes Kriti's handwritten funny rehearsal opener. Kriti notices the student is quick enough to improve the punchline; their own creative banter becomes a future friendship seed.

dialogue.speaker: Ritika
dialogue.line: Ma'am, aap serious face ke peeche itni dangerous comedy chhupati hain?

dialogue.speaker: Kriti
dialogue.line: Aur tum bina permission punchline bhi chura leti ho?

beats.seed: They can edit a short skit later, giving Kriti and Ritika a relationship independent of Arjun's attention.

beats.title: Camera timer changes the positions
beats.action: Arjun places phone on a stable shelf, sets ten-second timer. Harsh steps sideways jokingly to make space; Shivani turns quickly to join the row while Laksh shifts behind her. Their paths cross unexpectedly.

dialogue.speaker: Harsh
dialogue.line: Ten seconds mein picture bhi set karni hai aur image bhi!

beats.title: Laksh catches Shivani — main turning point
beats.action: Shivani loses balance for a beat. Laksh catches her near the clothed waist as she briefly braces a hand against his shoulder. Her dupatta slips sideways; she feels a sudden shiver of surprise before steadying herself. Laksh's usual quiet composure breaks for a second. The timer captures the candid.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Oh—Laksh! Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Laksh
dialogue.line: You're okay, ma'am?

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Haan, bilkul.

beats.note: The user liked this sudden physical beat. Do not invent an explicit sensation, retrospective guilt, permanent relationship change or second mandatory touch.

beats.title: The embarrassing photo is actually a great photo
beats.action: The shot freezes the just-ended moment. Harsh instantly teases Laksh; Nandini and Ritika join the laughter, while Shivani resumes her usual voice without an overlong internal monologue.

dialogue.speaker: Harsh
dialogue.line: Bhai, ek photo mein tune itni publicity le li?

dialogue.speaker: Nandini
dialogue.line: Publicity nahi, timing perfect thi!

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Tumhari timing achhi hoti toh classwork bhi time pe hota.

beats.title: Arjun notices the real competition
beats.action: Arjun watches the image, momentarily bothered that Laksh became the memorable figure despite Arjun organizing the picture. He does not announce jealousy; instead, he offers a second, properly framed shot and continues to engage the whole group.

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Ek proper frame aur—iss baar hero banne ka chance sabko milega.

dialogue.speaker: Pooja
dialogue.line: Pehle ensure karo koi frame se bhaage nahi.

beats.title: The two future hooks stay small
beats.action: Pooja asks Arjun to send her laughing candid to the college group. Kriti asks him to message the rehearsal punchline along with the photo. Each brief exchange offers a distinct future conversation, not appointments or guaranteed seductions.

dialogue.speaker: Kriti
dialogue.line: Aur haan, woh final line yaad rakhna. Sirf photo se marks nahi milenge.

dialogue.speaker: Arjun
dialogue.line: Ek photo aur ek line—dono yaad rahenge, ma'am.

beats.title: The four friends bring everyone back to earth
beats.action: Ritika sends Harsh and Laksh toward the corridor; Nandini collects the sheets. Their longtime comfort shows in quick jokes rather than retrospective history. Arjun follows them after returning the phone.

dialogue.speaker: Ritika
dialogue.line: Bas, photo session over. Harsh, Laksh—chalo!

dialogue.speaker: Harsh
dialogue.line: Ritika ki command toh principal ke notice se bhi fast aati hai.

beats.title: Normal goodbye, useful seeds
beats.action: The five students leave. Shivani puts down her cup and returns to her notes. Pooja laughs again at her candid; Kriti circles a line on her script. The photo moment is over, and the scene exits without an imposed psychological debrief.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Chalo, ab sach mein kaam.
